record.title: fermion
record.name: Fermion2
record.content: Fermions are particles with half integer ($1/2$, $3/2$, $5/2$ etc) spin. They are governed by the Pauli exclusion principle, meaning that no two fermions can occupy the same quantum state. From this principle, it is possible to derive the Fermi-Dirac distribution to derive non-interacting fermions. In the standard model of particle physics, there are 24 fermions: the 12 quarks and antiquarks, and the 12 leptons and anti-leptons.
